questions.prompt: Why can Anna not go to the cinema on Thursday evening?
questions.evidence: I am going to tap dance with my friends Thursday night.
questions.explanation: Anna 说周四晚上要和朋友跳踢踏舞。看望父母是 Marsha 周五的安排，公园慢跑是 Marsha 周一的安排；三个活动不能互换。
options: She is jogging in the park.

questions.prompt: What does Marsha usually do on Friday nights?
questions.evidence: Friday nights are when I visit my parents.
questions.explanation: Friday nights 指每逢周五晚上，visit my parents 是看望父母。教孩子音乐是 Anna 的周三安排，电影约会是最后另外找到的时间。

questions.prompt: Which activity does Marsha plan with a friend on Monday night?
questions.evidence: I’m going to jog in the park with my friend.
questions.explanation: 这句直接说明 Marsha 周一晚要和朋友在公园慢跑。她提到喜欢桌游不等于周一要玩桌游；踢踏舞是 Anna 的安排。

questions.prompt: What instrument will Anna teach children to play? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: I’m going to teach children how to play the ukulele.
questions.explanation: teach children how to play the ukulele 表示教孩子弹尤克里里。题目只要乐器名称，因此填 ukulele，不加 play 或 the。

questions.prompt: When do they finally decide to see the new film?
questions.evidence: It’s Saturday afternoon. This is always when I do my errands.
questions.explanation: 交谈当时是 Saturday afternoon；随后 Anna 提议半小时后开场的新电影，Marsha 决定把 errands 改到周日并说 Let’s go。周一和周三已经分别有其他安排。

questions.prompt: On which day will Marsha do her errands instead? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: I’ll do my errands on Sunday. Let’s go!
questions.explanation: instead 问的是调整后的日期。Marsha 原本周六下午办事，最后说 I’ll do my errands on Sunday，所以填 Sunday，不能仍填 Saturday。
